# Captured from hosted immediately before deletion, 2026-09-11.
# but that backfill does not preserve the raw original book_tropes rows or
# the tropes vocabulary definitions themselves. This file is that raw
# backup, so both are trivially reinstatable if ever needed:
#   - tropes vocabulary rows: re-insert directly using the "tropes_table"
#   - book_tropes rows: re-insert each "book_tropes_table" row via
#     (select id from books where title = '<title>' and author = '<author>'),
#     trope_id, confidence -- the same title/author-subselect pattern this
#     project always uses instead of raw UUIDs.
# === book_tropes_table (trope_id, confidence, book title, book author) ===
